description: This file defines CRUD API endpoints for managing search tools within a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, retrieving info, testing connection, and discovering available providers.

classes.name: CreateSearchToolRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new search tool.

classes.name: UpdateSearchToolRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating an existing search tool.

classes.name: TestSearchToolConnectionRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for testing search tool connection.

classes.name: SearchToolInfoResponse
classes.description: Response model for search tool information.

methods.name: _convert_datetime_to_str
methods.description: Converts datetime objects to ISO format strings or returns the value if already a string or None.

methods.name: list_search_tools
methods.description: Lists all available search tools from the database.

methods.name: create_search_tool
methods.description: Creates a new search tool entry in the database.

methods.name: update_search_tool
methods.description: Updates an existing search tool identified by ID.

methods.name: delete_search_tool
methods.description: Deletes a search tool by ID.

methods.name: get_search_tool_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific search tool by ID, with masked sensitive info.

methods.name: test_search_tool_connection
methods.description: Tests connection to a search provider with given parameters.

methods.name: get_available_search_providers
methods.description: Discovers available search providers and their UI names.
